evidence_summary: An export handler bypassed its established account policy helper.
recommendation_summary: Route access through the existing policy service and add a cross-account test.

evidence_summary: A search string was concatenated into a database statement.
recommendation_summary: Use a bound parameter and retain a focused test for quote characters.

evidence_summary: The detector flagged a dynamic sort expression.
recommendation_summary: No code change; the expression was selected from a fixed allow-list and the filter was bound.

evidence_summary: A requested document name was joined to a storage root without a resolved-location check.
recommendation_summary: Resolve the candidate location and reject names outside the configured root.

evidence_summary: A callback target accepted any HTTP host without an approved-destination policy.
recommendation_summary: Apply an approved host policy and confirm integration ownership.

evidence_summary: Request events stored complete incoming headers.
recommendation_summary: Log a small allow-list of operational fields and remove credentials or caller metadata.

evidence_summary: A scanner reported a package name found only in a documentation paragraph.
recommendation_summary: Do not report it as an installed component; verify the resolved environment inventory.

evidence_summary: An unauthenticated probe was reachable at the application boundary.
recommendation_summary: Confirm gateway routing, monitoring, and intended network exposure with the deployment owner.
